svg.title: Elmehdi Essamit
svg.desc: Elmehdi Essamit (akeanti). Electrical and energy engineering student at EHTP, first year, based in Casablanca. Power grids, energy and embedded systems. From the ESP32 sensor to the grid solver, every result checked against a reference. Open to a first-year internship, summer 2027, for 1 to 2 months. Now building: malfoid, last push 14 Oct 2026. Latest release: ariadne v3.0.0, 13 Oct 2026. Illustration: a portrait of me inside a ring of three rotating phasors drawing their sine waves.
